originalExpectedCaseNames: Source contract: only one user-action setter, no system-read getter or automatic wake-password path; unrelated sleep saves preserve preference
Default is off; exact title/description appear immediately above pause-game; page mount sends zero wake-password system IPC
The switch uses a real focusable button for keyboard/controller activation
Idle, page remount and global refresh do not read/write/activate the wake-password power setting
Only a user Space/A-style click sends enabled=true, unifies AC/DC and does not modify the sleep guard
User disable sends enabled=false for AC/DC=0 without a current/Balanced scheme argument
Pending write disables duplicate clicks and the switch changes only after verified ACK
Saved user choice survives F5 via existing sleep configuration only; restarting the page does not reapply it
Failed DC/policy write keeps original UI state and reports failure instead of pretending success
Missing/unreadable fixed plan reports error and leaves a retryable user switch; no automatic fallback to another plan
Power-transition/transport exception re-enables controls without automatic retries or false state
Hardware success plus preference-save failure reports only the memory failure, not a false power-setting failure
Other sleep switches and refresh preserve the remembered wake-password choice without touching its power setting
No wake-password polling, deferred reactivation, scheduled retry or idle work after the user action
